Describe the record, source, interface, documentation, or maintenance change.

## Source and scope review

- [ ] I linked the relevant issue or explained why one is not needed.
- [ ] I used an official primary source when one is available.
- [ ] I checked the jurisdiction, record type, legal status, dates, and scope.
- [ ] I kept factual description, plain-language explanation, and advocacy context separate.
- [ ] I documented important limitations, exceptions, or uncertainty.
- [ ] I added or updated the review date, record version, and history when a record changed.
- [ ] I did not rewrite archived NHGRI wording.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate:data`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`

List any check that could not be run and explain why.
